item.title: A new political era in the Southern Philippines
item.description: A new local government has taken its seat in the southern Philippines, in a step that marks a milestone in the peace process for a conflict that has lasted some 80 years.

item.title: France seethes again as youth-led protests sweep Europe
item.description: French Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez warned of a "very high risk" of disorder, especially after dark on Halloween, as some 320,000 people nationwide took to the streets.
